events.title: Demo Out Now
events.summary: The Dead Sector Demo is Live!A major milestone - the demo is now live! Jump in and play the demo free.I'm a solo developer, and player feedback means everything at this stage. If you give it a go, I'd love to hear what clicked, what frustrated you, and what you want to see more of - it directly shapes where the full game goes from here. Share your thoughts in the community here on Steam or jump into our Discord.Thanks for playing.

events.title: Demo Incoming
events.summary: Demo Lands This SeptemberDead Sector is a neon-isometric datacenter management sim about building your servers from the components up - then keeping it alive as the load climbs, the power sags, and the incidents start rolling in. And this month, you can play the preview of it for free.What is Dead Sector?Design your own servers.
